svg.title: Enabled SCL input debug view remains zero after one MFD START
svg.desc: Measured BCM70015 preboot fixed-colour configuration: two configuration-only and two single-START sessions. MFD PX_RD_BVB raw changes from 00080020 to 00080044; all sixteen active bundles per feed have SCL input-view2 DATA zero. Saved twenty-five-word paired controls returned exactly before stock powerdown. Eight native recovery controls passed whole-byte capture, EOS and scoped resources. Input acceptance, output, source or sink leases and processing completion remain unproved.
svg.text: BCM70015: enabled SCL input view2, one MFD START
Measured pre-CMAC trials · 2026-10-06 · two fresh configuration controls + two fresh feed sessions
Relative to the prior joint profile, only SCL TP_ADDR changes 3 → 2; MFD PX_RD_BVB selector0x0c unchanged.
FIXED=0x405ac3 · CTRL=0x0d · STRIDE=0 · HSIZE raw4 / WINDOW raw1 · SCL three size words0x00040002 / ENABLE request1
One complete 11-word baseline; not a current-transfer terminal.
All16 bundles equal; repeated feed series byte-exact. No sampled LAST/EOF.
Raw field labels, not transfer or state guarantees
MFD: FIFO_EMPTY 1→0 · FIFO_FULL 0→1 · PIXEL_STOP 0→1 · CSM raw0→0
SCL status/index words are opaque; no state enums or address following. PX_RD_BVB is not the READY/ACCEPT union.
Four deliberate pre-CMAC aborts: status−5 / download20 / commands0 / cleanup0 / retainedfalse; no START retry or live restore.
Each cold25 and pre-powerdown-retire25 pair matched exactly; saved controls equal across all four sessions.
Eight separate native controls: full180 frames each / 1,440 total; 82,944,000B each byte-equal to frozen gold; EOS / cleanup / fds / threads PASS.
Stock module/ref0 restored; final PCI fields match baseline after temporary MASTER clear. Raw evidence and RSS deltas are in the companion JSON.
Enabled input-view2 zero does not establish acceptance, routing, output, completion, source/sink leases or chip incapability.
Sequential observations are not atomic snapshots; mux/read timing may perturb. Ordinals and host attempt bounds are not elapsed time or accepted counts.
MASTER0 does not bound local autonomous activity; control reversion is not an all-consumer fence. Original issue92 goal remains unmet.
